movement: Automatic MonoBehaviour Update advances one fixed validated route. Existing SE Sprite reference stays constant. No walking animation or Unity dynamic pathfinder.
clock: Time.captureFramerate60 fixes game delta for QA; wall time is not a performance benchmark.
visibilityProbe: At selected actual PlayMode frames, same-frame camera captures temporarily hide the unit only for background pixel difference; no Sprite or transform is assigned by the observer.
